title: Lab 2D part 1 — Aurora Serverless v2 study stack

answers.explanation: DB SG inbound from app SG on DB port 5432 — Night 8/15 callback; night-16-lab wires lambda-stats-sg → aurora-sg.
DB subnet group must span ≥2 AZs for Aurora/RDS HA placement. night-16 uses Night 9 private-a + private-b.
Aurora Serverless v2 does not scale to zero — min ACU (0.5 here) bills while cluster exists. Night 15 trap.
RDS Data API + Secrets Manager secret + cluster ARN — setup -InitSchema path in night-16-lab-aurora-setup.ps1.
Private subnet + no public accessibility = no direct laptop psql. Use Data API or in-VPC Lambda (Night 17).
Writes use cluster writer endpoint. Reader endpoint is for read replicas only.
ManageMasterUserPassword stores secret; describe-db-clusters returns MasterUserSecret.SecretArn.
Databases in private subnets; NAT for outbound maintenance; SG rules for app access — Night 9/16 pattern.
ServerlessV2ScalingConfiguration is on the DB cluster; instance class is db.serverless.
Teardown removes Aurora + SGs + subnet group only — Night 9 VPC and Night 12–14 labs unchanged.
JOINs and relational reports → Aurora. DynamoDB for simple key access (Night 15 GSA split).
SQS decouples batch completion; stats uploader (Night 17) persists aggregates to Aurora resort_stats.
Never 0.0.0.0/0 on DB port — use SG reference or Data API/Lambda in VPC.
Lambda initiates outbound connections; no inbound listeners required on lambda-stats-sg.
Add a reader instance first; then reader endpoint load-balances SELECTs. With only a writer, reader endpoint still hits primary but adding replica is the scale-out pattern.
